description: This file defines a service class 'StorageBackendFileService' that manages file uploads to storage backends, creates file objects with storage metadata, generates unified file IDs, and integrates with a managed files system. It specifically handles interactions with storage backends like Azure Blob Storage and is tailored for managing OpenAI file objects within the application.

classes.name: StorageBackendFileService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to upload files to storage backends, create file objects with associated metadata, generate unified file identifiers, and interface with a managed files system.

methods.description: Handles uploading a file to the specified storage backend, creates a file object with storage metadata, and stores it in the managed files system if applicable.

methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded, unified file ID string using the file type, a new UUID, model names, and the original file ID.
